data.title: Chat: harden the AS-74 roster-title cascade guard — all: unset, native CSS nesting, orgNodeItem class set

data.body: Filed from the AS-74 review (Priya, M6 probes past the plan's list; none blocks AS-74 — all three are constructs style.css/app.js do not use today). Scope, three one-line-ish hardenings: (1) test/roster-truncation.test.js CONTRACT table has no 'all' row — appending '.roster-title { all: unset; }' resets white-space/overflow/text-overflow in a browser and T1 stays green (probe P6 survived, 6/0). Fix: ['all', [null]]. (2) The cascade parser silently mis-reads native CSS nesting: '#roster-list { .roster-title { white-space: normal; } }' appended — inner rule is swallowed by parseDecls as a garbage declaration, T1 green (P7 survived). Fix: throw in parseDecls/parseBlocks when a style-rule body contains '{', the same loud-failure choice the helper makes for :is/:where/:not/:has. (3) orgNodeItem has no complete-class-set pin (plan §10 offer): 'el("span", "org-extra")' inserted before the meta el() call reds nothing (P10 survived, api.test.js 62/0). Fix: a deepEqual class-set assertion over the orgNodeItem region using the AS-74 item-3 quote-agnostic regex. Predicted host count +0/+1; each fix gets its own named mutant (M4).

Planned (cto-owen, tick watcher:78911 loop tick 19; planning lane on Opus after a Fable 429 at spawn). All three of Priya's AS-74 probes reproduced on a scratch copy at the intended site (P6, P7 incl. the & form, P10); plan adopts her three fixes and adds one sibling pin (a classList.add set over orgNodeItem — row.classList.add('org-extra') survives the el()-only pin one line away), each with its own named mutant; AS-74's R1-R4 verified still red on the scratch. Orchestrator's call: the sibling pin stays (it has its own falsifier and closes a hole one line from the one being fixed). Base host 605/603/0/2 on aeeca77; predicted 606 host, 606/598/0/8 compose. Implementer Marcus (second pair of eyes on Lena's parser; Lena named on AS-109), reviewer Ruben (Priya filed the fixes). Branch feat/AS-112-cascade-guard-hardening linked, worktree .worktrees/AS-112 added.

Implementation complete on feat/AS-112-cascade-guard-hardening, commit 9d70ae6 (test-only: apps/chat/test/roster-truncation.test.js +39/-2, apps/chat/test/api.test.js +18; diff --stat master...branch names only those two files). Plan §1 applied as written: (1) CONTRACT gains ['all', [null]] and T1's null case renders 'undeclared' instead of 'unset' in both the by-string and the allowed list; (2) walk() throws 'cannot score nested style rule (native CSS nesting) under: <prelude>' when a style-rule body contains '{', placed after the UNSCORABLE throw and before parseDecls; new helper case H6 under exactly the §1.2 name, with (a) descendant, (b) '&' and (c) inside-@media nesting plus the intact @keyframes ignore path; (3) T2 gains the deepEqual el() class-set pin ['org-node-meta','org-node-name','org-node-row','org-tree'] and (3b) the classList.add sibling pin ['org-root'], both scoped to the orgNodeItem region.

CARDINALITY. Host baseline on the untouched worktree (master b4e1a80 code): 605/603/0/2, matching master's record — no re-baseline needed. After the edits: roster-truncation alone 7/7, api alone 63/63, full host suite 606/604/0/2 (base + H6, AC-1). Mutant battery: 10 mutants + 1 helper flip = 11 runs on a detached scratch worktree /tmp/AS-112-mutant at 9d70ae6 (green at 606 before the first mutant); whole suite per run; applied-check asserted at the intended site before each run (occurrence counts, region-scoped to orgNodeItem for app.js); restore by git checkout proven by empty porcelain and a post-restore run at 606/604/0/2 after every mutant.

OBSERVED RED SETS (each exactly one test red in 606 unless stated): M1 {T1} '.roster-title all: effective value is unset — won by .roster-title (spec 0,1,0, order 210); the contract allows undeclared' (211 rules parsed, 3 target); AS-32 CSS case green. M2 {T1} thrown 'cannot score nested style rule (native CSS nesting) under: #roster-list'; H6 green. M2b {T1} '…under: .roster-title'; H6 green. M3 {T2} 'orgNodeItem builds exactly these classes via el() — a missing one and a stray extra one both fail'; AS-32 rosterRow case green. M3b (single-quoted stray) {T2}, same message. M4 {T2} 'orgNodeItem adds exactly one class by classList — the board root marker'. R1 {T1} 'white-space: effective value is normal — won by .roster-title (spec 0,1,0, order 210)'. R2 {T1} 'won by #roster-list .roster-title (spec 1,1,0, order 50)'. R3 {T2} on the meta-line literal pin. R4 {AS-32 el() case} only — T2 GREEN, so the new pin is region-scoped as claimed. H6 flip (assert.throws -> assert.doesNotThrow on line a): T1 file alone 7/6/1, exactly {H6}, 'Got unwanted exception.' Deviations from the plan's §2 table: none. Survivors: none.

COMPOSE RECEIPT (node apps/chat/bin/compose-run.mjs --project asc-impl-as112 --cwd .worktrees/AS-112/apps/chat): 'Image asc-impl-as112-test Built'; tests=606 pass=598 fail=0 skipped=8; run exit 0, down exit 0, leak check clean — the predicted 606/598/0/8 (host skips + 6). No mode.test.js flake observed under the three-lane load.

CLEANUP: scratch worktree removed, no /tmp/AS-112-*, compose-run --check 'no leftovers', worktree porcelain empty. One observation for the record, not a finding: my very first host baseline invocation exited 1 before my parser could name the red (it grepped for TAP 'not ok' against the spec reporter); the next two baselines and every subsequent run were green, and two other lanes were running concurrently — consistent with the AS-83 condition, unattributed. Nothing left undone. Status transition to review is the orchestrator's.

VERDICT: PASS — merge. 0 blocking findings; 3 non-blocking findings outside the criteria list (all holes in the parent AS-74 guard T1, out of this task's stated scope, filed as AS-125); 3 records. Review by agent:qa-ruben on Opus (Fable-usage fallback), tick watcher:78911 loop tick 21. Read cold: plan §0–§6, then `git diff master...feat/AS-112-cascade-guard-hardening` (HEAD 9d70ae6, developer-marcus, actor-id identity correct). Marcus's implementation comment read LAST, after this text was written; the daemon's artifact not read.

CARDINALITY. Diff: 2 files, +55/−2, both under apps/chat/test/ (AC-7 holds: no public/, lib/, server.js, fixtures, .lattice/, top-level). Helper cases H1–H6: 6; CONTRACT rows: 13 (12 + `all`). style.css parses to 210 rules (211 with any one appended mutant), 3 targeting .roster-title. orgNodeItem region el() class set: 4; classList set: 1. Mutation runs: 27 total — 11 plan battery (M1, M2, M2b, M3, M3b, M4, R1–R4, H6 flip), 8 §6-named probes, 8 invented routes. Every run on a detached scratch worktree (/tmp/AS-112-ruben-mutant, since removed), applied-at-site asserted by occurrence count scoped to the intended region before the suite ran, whole suite per run (TAP), restored under an exit handler, porcelain proven empty after each. Driver + log: scratchpad/agent-qa-ruben/AS-112/{mutate.mjs,mutants.log}.

FINDINGS (outside the list; M6 budget spent where §6 pointed and past it).

F1 [defect in T1, non-blocking here, AS-125] — a selector that reaches the title div without the class literal is not targeting, and wins in a browser. `targets()` matches `\.roster-title` in the subject compound only; .roster-title is a `div` (app.js L506). Four survivors, each parsed into the rule set and rejected by `targets()` (traced): `#roster-list li.roster-row div { white-space: normal; }` (spec 1,2,1 beats 0,1,0); `#roster-list * { white-space: normal; }` (1,0,0 beats 0,1,0); `[class~="roster-title"] { white-space: normal; }` (same element, later order); `.roster\-title { white-space: normal; }` (escape resolves to the same class). Each: 606/604/0/2 green. Not live today: of the 12 type/universal-subject rules in style.css that declare a watched property, subjects are html/body/label/h2/li/header — none can match the div. Neither AS-74 §10 nor AS-112 §1 records this omission; it is the AS-45 shape one level down from P6/P7/P10.

F2 [defect in T1, non-blocking here, AS-125] — at-rule shapes swallowed silently. `@scope (#roster-list) { .roster-title { white-space: normal; } }` → walk() ignores the whole block (0 rules), browsers since Chrome 118/Safari 17.4/Firefox 128 apply it: green. A statement at-rule `@import url("x.css");` followed by `.roster-title { white-space: normal; }` → parseBlocks glues them into one prelude `@import …;\n.roster-title`, startsWith('@'), both dropped; a browser drops the misplaced @import and applies the rule: green. (`@layer x { … !important }` also green — that one IS a recorded omission in both plans, listed for completeness, not counted as new.)

F3 [plan §1.2 inaccuracy + T1 gap, non-blocking, AS-125] — "a `{` inside a string value would also throw" holds only when the braces balance. Balanced `content: "{}"` under `.roster-status::after` throws the new nesting error (observed). Unbalanced `content: "{"` followed by `.roster-title { white-space: normal; }` → parseBlocks never returns to depth 0, returns 0 blocks for both, T1 green at 606/604. style.css has 0 true `content:` declarations (the 9 hits are justify-content) so nothing is vacuous today. Cheapest tripwire: throw when depth ≠ 0 at EOF.

Records (no action): R-a `.t:is(.x)` inside a nested rule — the nesting throw fires first, message names the outer prelude `#roster-list` (§6 asked which; recorded). R-b `row.className = 'x'` and `row.setAttribute('class', …)` in orgNodeItem survive as §1 designed; I judge them not task-worthy — neither idiom appears in the function and either would replace the class set and visibly break org-node-row — noted in AS-125's description so nobody re-derives it. R-c a stray `el('span','org-extra')` in renderOrgChart does NOT red T2 (region scoping real, as R4 also shows). Concurrency: my first `--check` showed `asc-review-as111-bm_default` as a leftover from the parallel AS-111 review lane; not mine, not touched; gone by my last `--check`. Branch pair merge seams: this branch touches only two test files; no overlap with AS-109 (favicon guard) or AS-111 (events) surfaces.

FLOOR CHECK (§3, labelled as such — 9 of 9 pass; the 3 findings above are outside this list).
1. H6 exists under exactly the §1.2 name; host on $W: 606 / 604 / 0 / 2 (T1 file alone 7/7, api.test.js alone 63/63). PASS.
2. M1 (`all: unset` appended, `.roster-title {` 2→3, last index > `.roster-status {`) → exactly {T1}: ".roster-title all: effective value is unset — won by .roster-title (spec 0,1,0, order 210); the contract allows undeclared. 211 rules parsed, 3 target .roster-title". AS-32 CSS case green (whole-suite fail=1). PASS.
3. M2 → exactly {T1}, "cannot score nested style rule (native CSS nesting) under: #roster-list"; M2b → exactly {T1}, "…under: .roster-title"; H6 green in both. PASS.
4. M3 and M3b → exactly {T2}, "orgNodeItem builds exactly these classes via el()…" with actual `['org-extra','org-node-meta',…]`; M4 → exactly {T2}, "orgNodeItem adds exactly one class by classList…" actual `['org-extra','org-root']`. PASS.
5. R1 → {T1} "normal — won by .roster-title (spec 0,1,0, order 210)"; R2 → {T1} "won by #roster-list .roster-title (spec 1,1,0, order 50)"; R3 → {T2} on the meta-line pin; R4 → exactly {AS-32 el() case} with T2 green. PASS.
6. H6 flip (`assert.throws`→`assert.doesNotThrow` on (a)) → exactly {H6}, 7/6/1 in the T1 file alone, "Got unwanted exception… under: #r". PASS.
7. `--stat`: apps/chat/test/api.test.js +18, apps/chat/test/roster-truncation.test.js +39/−2, nothing else. PASS.
8. Compose `node apps/chat/bin/compose-run.mjs --project asc-review-as112 --cwd $W/apps/chat`: receipt line `Image asc-review-as112-test Built`; 606 / 598 / 0 / 8; run exit 0, down exit 0, leak check clean. Skip delta 6 = host 2 + the 6 opt-in/compose-only skips, as the plan's last receipt shape predicts. PASS.
9. Scratch worktree removed (`git worktree list` shows master, AS-109, AS-111, AS-112 only); `git -C $W diff --exit-code` clean, porcelain empty, HEAD 9d70ae6; post-teardown host on $W 606/604/0/2; `--check`: 3 production networks, no leftovers. PASS.

§6 probes: `all: revert-layer` and `all: initial` each → exactly {T1} ("effective value is revert-layer/initial … the contract allows undeclared"); `@media` nested inside `.roster-title { … }` → {T1} via the nesting throw naming `.roster-title`; `:is(` inside nested → R-a above; string brace → F3; className/setAttribute → R-b; renderOrgChart stray → R-c.

Red-set accounting: 11 plan-battery runs, 11 observed sets identical to §2's predictions (0 wider, 0 narrower). Of 8 §6 probes, 4 red as predicted, 4 green (3 by design, 1 the F3 gap the plan mis-predicted). Of 8 invented routes, 8 green — all filed. Nothing fixed inline; nothing committed. Task status untouched; Owen transitions and merges.

Read last, after the above was written: Marcus's implementation comment. His red sets, messages and compose receipt (asc-impl-as112, 606/598/0/8) match mine run for run; nothing above changes. His one recorded observation — a first host baseline that exited 1 before his parser named the red — did not reproduce here: 27 mutation runs + 3 host runs + 1 compose run under the same three-lane load, 0 unexplained reds.
